description: Synthetic validation composites made from existing real blue/red block cutouts and a generated indoor background. These verify inference integration, not physical distance accuracy.

projection_fixtures.blue-far.jpg: Block resized from the reference 230x235 cutout to 115x118: approximately half apparent size, corresponding to twice depth in the synthetic projection check.
projection_fixtures.blue-near.jpg: Block resized from the reference 230x235 cutout to 345x352: approximately 1.5x apparent size, corresponding to 2/3 depth in the synthetic projection check.
